code:
160       tdo_mux = jtag_ir_shift_q[0];
161     // here we are shifting the DR register
162     end else begin
163       unique case (jtag_ir_q)
164         IDCODE:         tdo_mux = idcode_q[0];   // Reading ID code
165         DTMCSR:         tdo_mux = dtmcs_tdo_i;   // Read from DTMCS TDO
166         DMIACCESS:      tdo_mux = dmi_tdo_i;     // Read from DMI TDO
167         default:        tdo_mux = bypass_q;      // BYPASS instruction
168       endcase
169     end
170   end
171 
172   // ----------------
173   // DFT
174   // ----------------
175   logic tck_n, tck_ni;
176 
177   cluster_clock_inverter i_tck_inv (
178     .clk_i ( tck_i  ),
179     .clk_o ( tck_ni )
180   );
181 
182   pulp_clock_mux2 i_dft_tck_mux (
183     .clk0_i    ( tck_ni     ),
184     .clk1_i    ( tck_i      ), // bypass the inverted clock for testing
185     .clk_sel_i ( testmode_i ),
186     .clk_o     ( tck_n      )
187   );
188 
189   // TDO changes state at negative edge of TCK
190   always_ff @(posedge tck_n, negedge trst_ni) begin : p_tdo_regs
191     if (!trst_ni) begin
192       td_o     <= 1'b0;
193       tdo_oe_o <= 1'b0;
194     end else begin
195       td_o     <= tdo_mux;
196       tdo_oe_o <= (shift_ir | shift_dr);
197     end
198   end
199 
200 logic trst_sync1, trst_sync2;
201 
202 always_ff @(posedge tck_i or negedge trst_ni) begin
203   if (!trst_ni) begin
204     trst_sync2 <= 1'b0;
205   end else begin
206     trst_sync2 <= trst_sync1;
207     trst_no    <= trst_sync2;
208   end
209 end
210 
211   // ----------------
212   // TAP FSM
213   // ----------------
214   // Determination of next state; purely combinatorial
215   always_comb begin : p_tap_fsm
216 
217     trst_sync1         = trst_ni;
218 
219     capture_dr         = 1'b0;
220     shift_dr           = 1'b0;
221     update_dr          = 1'b0;
222 
223     capture_ir         = 1'b0;
224     shift_ir           = 1'b0;
225     // pause_ir           = 1'b0; unused
226     update_ir          = 1'b0;
227 
228     unique case (tap_state_q)
229       TestLogicReset: begin
230         tap_state_d = (tms_i) ? TestLogicReset : RunTestIdle;
231         trst_sync1 = 1'b1;
232       end
233       RunTestIdle: begin
234         tap_state_d = (tms_i) ? SelectDrScan : RunTestIdle;
235       end
236       // DR Path
237       SelectDrScan: begin
238         tap_state_d = (tms_i) ? SelectIrScan : CaptureDr;
239       end
